PERSONAL.description: Written by a person to you or to a small group you belong to, whether friends, family or work: questions, replies, plans, news, a person at a company answering you about your own case. Keep it as correspondence.
do_not_mark: a newsletter or campaign written in a person's name but sent to many people (BULK)
a post to a mailing list or group of people who mostly don't know each other (LIST)
automated mail signed with a person's name, such as an account manager's welcome message (NOTIFICATION or BULK)
an invoice or receipt, even when a person sent it (TRANSACTIONAL)

TRANSACTIONAL.description: A record of something you bought, booked, paid or signed: receipts, invoices, order and booking confirmations, tickets, bank and card statements, tax documents, contracts. Keep it as a record, whoever sent it.
do_not_mark: shipping and delivery updates about an order (NOTIFICATION)
a reminder that a payment is due, without the bill or statement itself (NOTIFICATION)
offers from a shop you bought from (BULK)

NOTIFICATION.description: Automated mail about your own account or activity: alerts, sign-in codes, password resets and security notices, shipping and delivery updates, reminders, someone commenting on or liking something of yours, changes to a service you use. Useful for a while, rarely worth keeping.
do_not_mark: a record of a payment, order or booking (TRANSACTIONAL)
the same campaign or newsletter sent to everyone (BULK)
a person writing to you, even through a service's contact form (PERSONAL)

BULK.description: The same message sent to many people: newsletters, marketing and offers, product announcements, surveys, fundraising appeals, event invitations sent to a whole list. Safe to drop unless you want it.
do_not_mark: a group discussion where members write to each other (LIST)
a notice about your own account or activity (NOTIFICATION)
a receipt or booking that also carries an offer (TRANSACTIONAL)

LIST.description: A message to a mailing list or group where members write to each other: discussion lists, Google Groups, a club's, class's or project's list, and digests of such a list.
do_not_mark: a one-way newsletter, even one that comes through list software (BULK)
a thread among a few people you know, sent to them directly (PERSONAL)
notifications from a tool such as an issue tracker about something you follow (NOTIFICATION)
